title: 10 Deals a Godly Man Stops Making With His Own Sin
caption:
Every man who's still losing to the same sin has a negotiation running in the background. "Just this once." "After this season." "I've prayed about it." "This is just who I am."

None of those are surrender. They're deals. And a deal means you're still in the room with it, still bargaining, still telling yourself you're managing something you've actually just made peace with.

A godly man stops negotiating. Scripture doesn't say manage what's earthly in you. It says put it to death.

"For if you live according to the flesh you will die, but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live." (Romans 8:13)
